reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: I signed up for this from a social media app. It claims to email you an assessment of your attachment style and provide a form of CBT. No assessment was emailed, only a receipt. Once you get into the app it’s a glorified journaling app that mines your data and gives you AI response. You are better off simply getting a book about correcting attachment styles and paying for therapy. This is an expensive and useless journaling app that using misleading marketing that preys on struggling individuals to mine for data while providing trash AI prompts and responses. Save the money and a headache, go buy a book and a journal for less than the cost of this.

reviews.title: Reflections and analysis is powerful!
reviews.text:
I have been journaling for years- many journals filled with my prayers, thoughts and reflections.This journal is a step up for me, because it’s powerfully interactive. It helps me to notice things I may not see- that helps me a lot! 

I notice it changes ever so often- I love the new part that generates questions under each category .  This section only allows me to write in the categories IF I have written in the journal. I definitely give this journal 5 stars!
